items.title: BT delivered a strong first half, with further strategic momentum
items.text:
Allison Kirkby, Chief Executive, commenting on the results, said:
“BT delivered a strong first half, with further strategic momentum in a competitive market, resulting in growth in revenue, EBITDA and customer satisfaction. We are building the UK’s digital backbone, connecting and protecting the country like no-one else, while accelerating our transformation as we create a better BT for all of us.
“Openreach achieved record full fibre demand, with more than 10 million homes and businesses now connected and take-up reaching 41%. BT and EE have been recognised as the UK’s best broadband and mobile networks, while more households are choosing our mobile and TV services together. And our growing order book in Business is supported by leadership in secure and sovereign connectivity solutions.
“Our UK-centric strategy and transformation is clearly delivering with £312 million of annualised savings achieved in the first half, as we continue to simplify and modernise. Our proposed international joint venture with Verizon is progressing at pace, and we’ve also stepped up for the country with the acquisition of TalkTalk, protecting millions of customers while creating value for all our stakeholders. We are reiterating our mid-term guidance, including normalised free cash flow of c.£3.0bn by the end of the decade. For this fiscal year, we are on track to deliver normalised free cash flow of c.£2.0bn, excluding the effects of the TalkTalk transaction. We’re also announcing an increased interim dividend to 2.5 pence per share.”
Consistently delivering against our strategic priorities in competitive markets
Record customer demand for Openreach FTTP with over 1.1m net adds in H1; total premises connected 9.9m, now >50% of broadband and bringing our market-leading take-up rate to 41%; more than 10m connections reached in October; Openreach broadband ARPU of £17.8 grew 7% year on year, driven by CPI-linked price increases, higher FTTP take-up and speed mix
FTTP footprint increased to 24.1m, with 1.2m premises passed in the six-month period; we now expect to reach our 25m build target in March
Openreach broadband line losses were 175k in Q2 and 366k in the six-month period; we continue to expect losses of c.800k in the year
BT and EE network leadership recognised with historic double awards, with RootMetrics recognising EE as the UK's Best Mobile Network for the 13th consecutive year, and Ookla recognising BT's Full Fibre network as the best in the UK; 5G+ population coverage rose to 81%, up from 73% in March
Record retail FTTP base growth in H1 with Consumer up 574k to 4.7m and Business up 40k to 0.4m, taking FTTP to 54% of the broadband base
Consumer customer base up 86k in postpaid mobile and 26k in TV, down 7k in broadband; churn remains stable year on year
Consumer ARPU of £40.8 in broadband, down 3% year on year, reflecting lower voice revenue and a competitive market; £19.8 in postpaid mobile, up 3% year on year; Consumer fixed and mobile convergence increased to 27.1% from 25.9% a year ago
Business momentum built through the period, with strong sales order growth including contracts with the Ministry of Justice, the Cabinet Office, Scottish Water and Royal Mail; Microsoft partnership deepened in security; brand consideration is building following our BT brand relaunch
Transformation programme remains on track to deliver £3.5bn of gross annualised cost savings by FY30 on a continuing operations basis; in the six-month period £312m of savings were delivered taking cumulative total savings to £1.7bn at a cost to achieve of £0.8bn; operational efficiencies continued to improve year on year, with network energy usage down 7%, total labour resource down 11% to 90k, and Openreach repair volumes down 16%

items.title: BT Group announces triennial pension valuation
items.text:
BT Group (“BT”) and the BT Pension Scheme (“BTPS”) have agreed the 30 June 2026 triennial funding valuation (“2026 valuation"):
The Scheme’s funding position has continued to improve, with the deficit reducing from £3.7bn at June 2023 to £2.7bn at June 2026, and the funding level increasing from 91.0% to 92.3%.
Payments agreed at the 2023 valuation will address £2.1bn of the deficit and will be substantially replaced by zero-coupon bonds shortly after this announcement. Payments scheduled directly to the BTPS totalling £30m will be brought forward and paid in FY27; the remaining FY28-FY31 scheduled contributions will be replaced with zero-coupon bonds with the same payment profile, issued by BT. BT will continue to make annual payments of £180m under the asset-backed funding arrangement established in 2021.
BT will need to provide £282m of additional funding to ensure the BTPS remains on track to reach full funding by 2030. The additional BT funding of £282m will be provided shortly through a zero-coupon bond maturing in 2033.
The above measures will substantially reduce the funding deficit, to around £0.3bn, which will be addressed by expected future investment returns to 2030. No further deficit contributions are expected to be required for BTPS to reach full funding.
The wider package of measures both improves the security of the Scheme and provides BT with greater corporate flexibility, reflecting the BTPS’s improved funding position, BT’s improved covenant, and additional security agreed as part of the valuation. The wider package:
provides £4bn of security, through a new charge over EE shares, giving the BTPS extra protection in the unlikely event of BT becoming insolvent;
allows shareholder distributions of up to £1.5bn in FY27, increasing to £2.0bn by FY30, without triggering additional payments to BTPS;
moves to a more objective test to determine if a refund is paid to BT; and
establishes principles for addressing a deficit if one exists at a future triennial valuation.
Patricia Cobian, BT Group Chief Financial Officer, said: “This agreement supports our capacity to continue to invest in next-generation networks and transform BT. It reflects our disciplined approach to capital allocation, balancing long-term investment, our pension commitments, sustainable dividend growth and a strong balance sheet.”
Jill Mackenzie, Trustee Chair of the BTPS, said: “We are pleased with the progress made since the last valuation despite high levels of macroeconomic volatility and uncertainty. The deficit has reduced, security strengthened and we remain on track to achieve full funding by 2030.”

AXA today announced the placement of Euro 750 million of Reg S subordinated notes due 2057 (the “Notes”) with institutional investors. This issuance is part of AXA Group’s funding plan, and the proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including the refinancing of part of AXA Group’s outstanding debt. The settlement of the Notes is expected to take place on November 6, 2026.
The Notes will have a fixed annual interest rate of 5.375% until May 25, 2037, the first call date, following which the interest rate will be a floating rate based on 3-month EURIBOR plus a margin of 295 basis points.
The Notes qualify as Tier 2 capital under Solvency II. They will be treated as capital from a regulatory and rating agency perspective within applicable limits.
They are expected to be rated A by S&P Global Ratings and A1 (hyb) by Moody’s.

NEW YORK, Tuesday, November 3, 2026 — Pfizer Inc. (NYSE: PFE) reported financial results for the third quarter of 2026 and raised its full-year 2026 guidance(2) for both Revenues and Adjusted(3) diluted EPS.
EXECUTIVE COMMENTARY
Dr. Albert Bourla, Chairman and CEO of Pfizer:
"Pfizer had another strong quarter with commercial momentum and disciplined execution while advancing our strategy for creating long-term shareholder value. Our obesity program continued to advance and recent milestones in oncology, immunology and vaccines further demonstrate the potential of our pipeline. With a robust slate of expected catalysts ahead, I believe we're well positioned to deliver meaningful new medicines for patients and lasting value in the years ahead."
Cecile Guegan, CFO and EVP of Pfizer:
“Our third-quarter results reflect strong commercial performance globally and continued operational discipline. This quarter, our non-COVID products delivered strong 7% operational revenue growth, and I’m particularly pleased with the 32% year-over-year operational revenue growth from our launched and acquired products(1). Today, we are raising our full-year 2026 Revenue and Adjusted diluted EPS guidance, reflecting our strong year-to-date performance and confidence in our business.”

Under the Classic offer, the subscription price is equal to 80% of the Reference Price, i.e., Euro 33.86.
Under the Guarantee Plus offer, the subscription price is equal to 93.95% of the Reference Price, i.e., Euro 39.75.
Further information on each of these offers can be found in the press release relating to Shareplan 2026 dated September 9, 2026, and published on axa.com.

SEATTLE—(BUSINESS WIRE) October 29, 2026—Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN) today announced financial results for its third quarter ended September 30, 2026.
•Net sales increased 12% to $201.9 billion in the third quarter, compared with $180.2 billion in third quarter 2025. Excluding the $0.9 billion unfavorable impact from year-over-year changes in foreign exchange rates throughout the quarter, net sales increased 13% compared with third quarter 2025. As a reminder, Prime Day timing shifted this year, with the event occurring in Q2 for most large countries. In 2025, Prime Day occurred entirely in Q3. Excluding this shift, third quarter year-over-year growth would have been approximately 400 basis points higher.
•North America segment sales increased 6% year-over-year to $112.9 billion.
•International segment sales increased 5% year-over-year to $43.1 billion, or increased 8% excluding changes in foreign exchange rates.
•AWS segment sales increased 39% year-over-year to $46.0 billion.
•Operating income increased to $28.1 billion in the third quarter, compared with $17.4 billion in third quarter 2025.
•North America segment operating income was $8.7 billion, compared with $4.8 billion in third quarter 2025.
•International segment operating income was $1.6 billion, compared with $1.2 billion in third quarter 2025.
•AWS segment operating income was $17.8 billion, compared with $11.4 billion in third quarter 2025.
•Net income decreased to $20.7 billion in the third quarter, or $1.89 per diluted share, compared with $21.2 billion, or $1.95 per diluted share, in third quarter 2025. This decrease is driven primarily by pre-tax gains of $9.5 billion in third quarter 2025 included in non-operating income (expense) from our investments in Anthropic.
•Operating cash flow increased 29% to $168.3 billion for the trailing twelve months, compared with $130.7 billion for the trailing twelve months ended September 30, 2025.
•Free cash flow decreased to an outflow of $42.4 billion for the trailing twelve months, driven primarily by a year-over-year increase of $94.8 billion in purchases of property and equipment, net of proceeds from sales and incentives. This increase primarily reflects investments in artificial intelligence. This compares to free cash flow inflow of $14.8 billion for the trailing twelve months ended September 30, 2025.
“Our AWS investment in functionality and infrastructure is working, with over 39% year-over-year revenue growth in Q3 ($184 billion revenue run rate) and projected revenue growth rates of over 40% both in 2027 and in 2028,” said Andy Jassy, President and CEO, Amazon. “Our broader selection and speedier delivery are helping us capture more retail market segment share with improving margins, and our newer businesses, ranging from Grocery to Pharmacy to Amazon Leo to Zoox are progressing encouragingly. There has never been a trillion dollar revenue business, and we may have two of them in the next 5-10 years.”

•Signed new AWS agreements with Meta, NVIDIA, OpenAI, Salesforce, Oracle, Qualcomm, Verizon, ADP, Stripe, Accenture Edge, Novo, Fanatics, Zoom, Raymond James, Prometheus AI, AppFolio, Instructure, Cognition, Sigma, Lila Sciences, The Biological Computing Co., NATO, Columbia University Irving Medical Center, and more.
•Drove continued rapid growth for Amazon Bedrock, AWS’s inference service, with Fortune 500 companies spending nearly 7x more year-over-year and total Bedrock token volume growing nearly 17x year-over-year.
•Expanded Bedrock’s leading selection of frontier and open weight models, adding OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, and GPT-6.1 Sol; Anthropic’s Claude Fable 5.1, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, and Haiku 5.5; Moonshot AI’s Kimi K3; SpaceXAI’s Grok 4.7; Z.ai’s GLM 5.3; and two purpose-built cybersecurity models from OpenAI.

•Launched public preview of Bedrock Managed Agents, which is a managed service powered by OpenAI that makes it faster for enterprises to build and deploy production-ready AI agents.

•Released Strands harness, a fully assembled, state-of-the-art agent harness that developers can get working with a single line of code and build custom agents that can run locally, on Bedrock AgentCore, or on a provider of their choice. Strands harness lowers the cost of agent tasks by 32% through greater token efficiency than other harnesses when using the same frontier models, while achieving equal or better accuracy.
•Previewed Strands Box, an open source sandbox that gives developers the ability to define rules for agent behavior and access, helping to prevent autonomous agents from causing unintended harm. •Drove continued rapid adoption of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, AWS’s fully managed service for building, connecting, and optimizing agents securely at scale using any model and open source framework, including Strands. GENERAL
Microsoft is a technology company committed to making digital technology and artificial intelligence (“AI”) available broadly and doing so responsibly. Our mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more.
We develop and support a broad portfolio of technology solutions for individuals and businesses, focusing on secure, trusted, and innovative platforms and applications that meet evolving customer needs across AI, cloud computing, productivity and collaboration, and personal computing. We strive to create opportunity, growth, and impact in every country around the world.
AI is fundamentally transforming productivity for every individual, organization, and industry. Microsoft's AI offerings span every layer of the technology stack, enabling transformative outcomes across sectors and unlocking opportunity for every country, community, and individual.
We believe AI should be as empowering as it is powerful, and we’re committed to designing and deploying AI responsibly with safety and security from the outset.
What We Offer
Founded in 1975, we develop and support software, services, devices, and solutions that deliver new value for customers and help people and businesses realize their full potential.
We offer an array of services, including cloud-based solutions that provide customers with AI, software, services, platforms, and content, and we provide solution support and consulting services. We also deliver relevant online advertising to a global audience.
Our products include operating systems, server applications, business solution applications, software development tools, desktop and server management tools, and video games. We also design and sell devices, including PCs, tablets, gaming and entertainment consoles, other intelligent devices, and related accessories.
Digital transformation and adoption of AI continues to revolutionize more business workstreams for organizations in every sector across the globe. For enterprises, digital technology empowers employees, optimizes operations, engages customers, and in some cases, changes the very core of products and services.
The Microsoft Cloud provides integration across the technology stack while offering openness, improving time to value, reducing costs, and increasing agility. Our cloud business benefits from three economies of scale: datacenters that deploy computational resources at significantly lower cost per unit than smaller ones; datacenters that coordinate and aggregate diverse customer, geographic, and application demand patterns, improving the utilization of computing, storage, and network resources; and multi-tenancy locations that lower application maintenance labor costs.
We prioritize security above all else and we offer our customers integrated AI-driven products addressing security, compliance, identity, management, and privacy across customers’ multi-cloud, application, and device assets.

Build the leading platform for applications and agents that brings together productivity and developer tools, industry solutions, data, security, and global-scale cloud and AI infrastructure to help organizations and individuals transform how they work and operate.

IBM RELEASES THIRD-QUARTER RESULTS
Exceeded expectations with accelerated revenue growth led by Software and Infrastructure; Raises outlook for full-year free cash flow
ARMONK, N.Y., October 21, 2026 . . . IBM (NYSE: IBM) today announced third-quarter 2026 earnings results.
“Disciplined execution throughout the quarter drove accelerated revenue growth and strong free cash flow. Our clients are now deploying Super Intelligence in ways that transform entire operating models, instead of simply addressing narrow or novel problems. IBM's technology and expertise are helping organizations drive growth and serve customers with greater speed, precision and efficiency than ever before," said Arvind Krishna, IBM chairman, president and chief executive officer. "For the full year, we continue to expect constant currency revenue growth in the range of four-to-five percent, and we now expect free cash flow to increase by more than $1 billion year-over-year.”
Third-Quarter Highlights
•Revenue
–Revenue of $17.1 billion, up 5 percent, up 6 percent at constant currency
–Software revenue up 8 percent, up 9 percent at constant currency
–Consulting revenue flat, up 2 percent at constant currency
–Infrastructure revenue up 4 percent, up 5 percent at constant currency
•Profit
–Gross Profit Margin: GAAP: 56.8 percent, down 50 basis points; Operating (Non-GAAP): 58.5 percent, down 20 basis points
–Pre-Tax Income Margin: GAAP: 14.6 percent, down 30 basis points; Operating (Non-GAAP): 19.3 percent, up 70 basis points
•Cash Flow
–Year to date, net cash from operating activities of $11.8 billion; free cash flow of $7.8 billion

•Financing — revenues of $0.2 billion, down 4 percent, down 3 percent at constant currency
Cash Flow and Balance Sheet
In the third quarter, the company generated net cash from operating activities of $4.0 billion, up $0.9 billion year to year. IBM’s free cash flow was $3.0 billion, up $0.7 billion year to year. The company returned $1.6 billion to shareholders in dividends in the third quarter.
For the first nine months of the year, the company generated net cash from operating activities of $11.8 billion, up $2.6 billion year to year. IBM's free cash flow was $7.8 billion, up $0.6 billion year to year.
IBM ended the third quarter with $11.1 billion of cash, restricted cash and marketable securities, down $3.4 billion from year-end 2025. The company invested $11.4 billion in acquisitions this year. Debt, including IBM Financing debt of $12.7 billion, totaled $63.8 billion, up $2.6 billion year to date.
Full-Year 2026 Expectations
•Revenue: The company continues to expect full-year constant currency revenue growth in the range of four-to-five percent. At current foreign exchange rates, currency is expected to be neutral to growth for the year
•Free cash flow: The company now expects full-year free cash flow to increase by more than $1 billion year-over-year
Dividend Declaration
The IBM board of directors approved a regular quarterly cash dividend of $1.69 per common share, to stockholders of record on November 10, 2026. With payment of the December 10, 2026 dividend, IBM will have paid consecutive quarterly dividends every year since 1916.

items.title: BT International expands Global Fabric with a choice of integrated security service edge solutions
items.text:
BT’s AI-ready networking platform now offers optimised connectivity to security service edge (SSE) solutions from Cisco, Fortinet, Netskope and Zscaler.
The new capability can help customers rapidly scale use of AI agents, cloud applications and autonomous digital workflows.
BT International today announced the expansion of its Global Fabric network-as-a-service (NaaS) platform with a choice of security service edge (SSE) solutions to support multinational customers’ rapid deployment and scaling of AI agents, cloud applications and autonomous digital workflows.
As organisations adopt AI at scale, traffic patterns across the network are dramatically changing. A growing number of users, AI agents, applications and devices are demanding more bandwidth, lower latency and access to multiple clouds from more locations. Many CIOs now find that traditional network and security architectures lack the performance, scale, visibility and control needed to support these new demands.
By providing optimised connectivity between Global Fabric and SSE solutions from leading vendors Cisco, Fortinet, Netskope and Zscaler, BT International enables customers to select more predictable, high-performance routes for their traffic, improving application responsiveness and delivering the best user experience.
It does this thanks to Global Fabric’s cloud-centric architecture. Unlike traditional SSE deployments, where traffic may cross many third-party internet networks before reaching a security inspection point, Global Fabric provides optimised connectivity to the vendors’ security and cloud ecosystems at a choice of strategic cloud locations around the world.
The new capability extends Global Fabric’s growing ecosystem of networking, cloud and security services. It is the latest step in the expansion of the platform, which offers consistent security, optimised application performance and proactive network management in a single controlled environment built on a brand-new network underlay.
Yash Jethani, Principal Analyst, ISG, said: “The convergence of networking and security is ultimately about enabling trust at scale. Global enterprises increasingly require a cloud-delivered operating model that provides resilient connectivity, consistent security enforcement and simplified operations across users, applications, AI agents and digital ecosystems worldwide. The ability to deliver that trust consistently across markets will be a key competitive differentiator.”
Matt Swinden, managing director, strategy & product, BT International, said: “Agentic AI is changing what organisations need from networks. AI agents depend on secure, reliable access to applications, data and cloud services in real time, creating new demands for performance, resilience and security. By bringing together SSE with Global Fabric, we're helping customers build an AI-ready network foundation upon which they can scale innovation and automation and choose the best security services to meet their needs.”
ENDS
Notes to editors
BT International managed SASE services
BT International works with a carefully selected ecosystem of leading secure access service edge (SASE) technology partners and has deep experience delivering managed security services at scale, defending its own network and customers against thousands of cyber threats every day. SASE includes SD-WAN and SSE solutions.
By integrating SSE with Global Fabric, BT International is offering customers:
Enhanced SD-WAN & SSE (SASE) service quality via Internet exchange point (IXP) peering - strengthening BT’s SD-WAN internet breakout performance by minimising path latency and propagation delay.
Stronger vendor ecosystem integration - peering enables tight integration with infrastructure-as-a-service (IaaS) providers, SaaS providers and security vendors.
Improved network resilience and path diversity between Global Fabric sites and SSE PoPs - delivered via a scalable global interconnect fabric and moving towards a deterministic self-healing network.
Improved quality of experience for end users through a performance-focused minimised data path (intelligent routing).
Consistent global security and networking experience - the same experience regardless of user location, with predictable latency and security policy application for traffic on Global Fabric.
The ability to avoid many third-party ISPs, providing an optimal path and associated benefits that the Global Fabric platform offers.
A choice of BT managed SASE solutions from leading vendors, with a cloud-native architecture, consistent security, optimised application performance and proactive network management in a single environment controlled by BT International’s Global Fabric-SASE managed service.

items.title: BT partners with ITV across Coronation Street and Emmerdale in landmark brand collaboration
items.text:
Created with WPP Media’s OpenConnect, the partnership embeds BT naturally into two of Britain’s most-loved soaps through set integrations, bespoke ads and storyline-led reactive spots.
The dual soap product placement deal will embed BT naturally into the worlds of Coronation Street and Emmerdale over the next 12 months.
The first-of-its-kind creative execution combines bespoke partnership ads and in-show integration, with ads featuring elements from both soaps and airing in the break that connects Emmerdale and Coronation Street.
Four bespoke ads featuring BT employees demonstrate how the company helps keep Britain connected, bringing to life its award-winning mobile and broadband networks alongside its support for 999 services, cyber security, and small business support.
LONDON, 12 October 2026 - BT is bringing its new brand platform, ‘Behind Brilliant Things’, into the heart of British culture through a creative partnership with ITV that will see the brand woven into the worlds of Coronation Street and Emmerdale over the next 12 months.
This first-of-its-kind partnership unites two of the UK’s best-loved soaps with the UK’s best network in a shared ambition to champion the brilliant things that keep the country connected. It brings together several industry-leading firsts and marks one of ITV’s most ambitious creative brand collaborations to date. This dual soap product placement deal is the first time a brand has united Coronation Street and Emmerdale in one bespoke partnership ad featuring elements from both programmes.
‘Behind Brilliant Things’ shines a light on the vital role BT plays in keeping homes, businesses and vital public services connected and protected every day, across every corner of the country. From powering the nation’s emergency services network to helping stop more than four million scam attempts every day, the campaign showcases the technology and people behind everyday life.
The partnership includes four bespoke ads, created by ITV, set against the backdrop of both programmes, each highlighting BT’s roles in society using BT employees and the sound of the BT Speaking Clock.
Across the next 12 months, BT will become a familiar presence in Coronation Street and Emmerdale with broadband routers in the Rovers, WiFi signage in the Woolpack, bus stop posters, BT vehicles and other products and services integrated naturally into the settings viewers know so well.
Reactive spots will evolve in line with key soap storylines, while cast-led social content will give audiences a closer look at the communities, stories and production of both programmes. BT has also secured licence rights to use the Coronation Street and Emmerdale logos across selected platforms.
Helen Whetton, Brand and Marketing Director at BT, said: “Millions of people rely on BT every day, often without even thinking about it. We’re there in the background, connecting homes, businesses and communities and helping everyday life keep moving. Coronation Street and Emmerdale have been part of British life for generations, telling stories about communities people know, recognise and care about. That shared connection to everyday Britain makes this partnership feel completely natural and gives us a powerful way to champion the people, communities and moments behind brilliant things.”
Bhavit Chandrani, Director of BE Studio at ITV, said: "We’re delighted to bring BT into the worlds of Coronation Street and Emmerdale in what is one of our most ambitious brand partnerships to date. Both shows are built on everyday moments and authentic stories, making them a natural space for BT as they launch their ‘Behind Brilliant Things’ platform. From in-show integrations to bespoke adverts linking both soaps, it’s a great example of how BE Studio brings brands closer to our content with innovative, multi-platform executions that help build real, lasting connections with audiences."
Rebecca Marshall, OpenConnect Senior Vice President at WPP Media, added: "The strongest brand partnerships are the ones that feel like part of the story. By bringing BT's ‘Behind Brilliant Things’ platform into the trusted worlds of Coronation Street and Emmerdale, we've created a collaboration that blends seamlessly into the viewing experience while demonstrating the vital role BT plays in everyday life. It allows BT to show not just what the brand does, but how its networks, technology and people help communities, businesses and services across Britain thrive."

FY2026 revenue: 336.7 billion yen (+1.8%), business profit: 31.5 billion yen (+11.0%).
Fourth-quarter sales struggled due to lingering issues with satisfying ongoing demand for Summer items and balancing product lineup, as the brand switched over to a new collection from Fall Winter 2026.
Improved the quality of operations by tightening product numbers and focusing on strong-selling items, and enhancing sales planning precision.
Global Brands: Reports a decline in revenue but an increase in profit in FY2026
While Global Brands revenue decreased to 128.5 billion yen (−2.3%), business profit increased to 2.8 billion yen (+6.8%).
The Theory business is in a global structural reform transitional period, which resulted in a decline in full-year revenue and a largely steady level of profit in local currency terms. The PLST business reported higher revenue and profit. The Comptoir des Cotonniers/Princesse tam.tam business reported a decline in full-year revenue and a slight contraction in business losses in local currency terms. Operating losses contracted significantly compared to the previous year, in which an impairment loss was recorded.
FY2027 consolidated estimates: Forecast another record performance on significant revenue and profit gains
FY2027 consolidated revenue: 4.4500 trillion yen (+12.3%), consolidated business profit: 830.0 billion yen (+15.5%), and profit attributable to owners of the Parent: 560.0 billion yen (+3.2%).
We forecast an annual dividend in FY2027 of 900 yen per share, split equally between interim and year-end dividends of 450 yen each. That would represent an increase in the annual dividend of 50 yen compared to FY2026.
FY2026 in Focus
UNIQLO Japan: Reports full-year revenue and profit gains, achieves a record performance
UNIQLO Japan achieved a record performance in fiscal 2026, after reporting year-on-year revenue and profit gains. UNIQLO Japan revenue totaled 1.0848 trillion yen (+5.7% year-on-year) and business profit expanded to 196.0 billion yen (+8.1% year-on-year). Full-year same-store sales expanded by 5.1% year-on-year, with the buoyant sales performance being driven by highly functional ranges, such as Ultra Stretch Pants and UV Protection items, and products that reflected on-trend silhouettes, such as Barrel Pants. The gross profit margin contracted by 0.1 point year-on-year. In the first half from 1 September 2025 through 28 February 2026, the gross profit margin contracted by 0.2 points after a weakening in yen rates on forward exchange contracts used for procurement purposes inflated the cost of sales ratio. However, that was followed by a 0.3 point improvement in the gross profit margin in the second half of the year, from March 1, 2026 through August 31, 2026. While yen rates on the forward exchange contracts used for procurement purposes weakened during the second half, the volume of additional production orders decreased, reducing the impact of spot exchange rates and improving the cost of sales ratio. Meanwhile, the selling, general and administrative expense ratio improved by 0.4 points to 32.6%, due to lower personnel and store rent expense ratios primarily in the first half of the year.
UNIQLO International: Reports large full-year revenue and profit gains, achieves a record performance
UNIQLO International reported a record high performance in fiscal 2026 on the back of significant increases in both revenue and profit, with revenue rising to 2.4111 trillion yen (+26.2% year-on-year) and business profit expanding to 439.8 billion yen (+44.1% year-on-year). The business profit margin also improved following the reporting of double-digit revenue and profit growth across all regional operations.

Chevron to Divest its Ownership Interests in Hess Midstream and DJ Basin Crude Midstream Assets
•Chevron to divest its ownership interests in Hess Midstream and DJ Basin crude oil midstream assets in exchange for extended and improved Bakken midstream commercial terms
•Expected to improve Chevron’s Bakken cost structure and increase return on capital employed
•Supports competitive upstream development activity
HOUSTON, October 6, 2026 — Chevron Corporation (NYSE: CVX) announced today that several of its subsidiaries have entered into a series of definitive agreements with Hess Midstream LP (NYSE: HESM) to restructure the terms of its Bakken midstream contracts and establish new DJ Basin midstream contracts. The revised agreements extend the Bakken contracts and are expected to reduce Chevron's Bakken unit midstream costs by approximately 50%, enhancing future earnings and return on capital employed. In exchange for the improved long-term commercial framework and $200 million in cash consideration, Chevron will transfer to Hess Midstream its ownership interests and general partner position in Hess Midstream, as well as its DJ Basin crude oil midstream assets.
As part of this transaction, Chevron expects to fully deconsolidate Hess Midstream, including approximately $3.7 billion of Hess Midstream's debt. Chevron expects this transaction to be accretive to return on capital employed by 0.5% on an absolute basis and generate long-term future economic value through a lower cost structure and improved earnings. At closing, Chevron expects to recognize a one-time after-tax loss estimated at approximately $3 to $4 billion,1 given that the company is unable to recognize future Bakken midstream cost savings as an asset.
“This transaction resets the commercial framework between our upstream and midstream assets in the Bakken and DJ Basins,” said Andy Walz, Chevron’s President of Downstream, Midstream and Chemicals. “It lowers our Bakken cost structure while positioning Hess Midstream to advance as an independent company.” Chevron expects to sustain Bakken production through ongoing technology deployment and operational improvements drawn from its global shale and tight portfolio.

Approvals and Timing
The transaction has been approved by the Conflicts Committee of the Board of Directors of the general partner of Hess Midstream, comprised entirely of independent directors, following consultation with its independent legal and financial advisors. The transaction is subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals and is expected to close by year-end 2026.

BofA Securities is acting as financial advisor and Latham & Watkins LLP is acting as legal advisor to Chevron. ARMONK, N.Y., October 1, 2026 . . . The IBM (NYSE: IBM) board of directors has elected Frank Baker to the board, effective October 1, 2026.
Frank Baker, 53, is a Co-founder and the Managing Partner of Siris Capital Group, LLC (“Siris”). Siris is a leading private equity firm that has deployed more than $9 billion of equity capital since inception across technology, telecommunications, and data-focused companies.
Arvind Krishna, IBM chairman, president and chief executive officer, said: “We are excited to welcome Frank Baker to our Board of Directors. I look forward to the perspective and insight Frank will bring as we advance our long-term vision and drive enterprise‑wide transformation through technology both for our clients and across IBM. His deep expertise, proven leadership, and strategy-driven mindset will strengthen our business and further deliver significant value to our shareholders.”
Mr. Baker oversees Siris’ portfolio and leads its investment strategy, driving value creation in established technology companies with mission-critical products and services that are navigating technology changes. His leadership and passion for development have been instrumental in driving the firm’s success.

He currently serves as a trustee of the University of Chicago, Chairman of the Board of the Robert & Ethel Kennedy Human Rights Center, and trustee of Deerfield Academy.

DALLAS (Sept. 17, 2026) – Texas
Instruments Incorporated (TI) (Nasdaq: TXN) today said it will raise its quarterly cash dividend 7%, from $1.42 per share to $1.52, or
$6.08 annualized. The higher dividend will be payable November 10, 2026, to stockholders of record on October 30, 2026, contingent upon
formal declaration by the board of directors at its regular meeting in October.
The increase is consistent with TI’s
long-term objective for dividends by providing a sustainable and growing dividend and reflects the company’s continued commitment
to return all free cash flow to its owners over time. Today’s announcement marks 23 consecutive years of dividend increases.

items.title: AXA Launches an Online Risk Prevention Program for Youth
items.text:
AXA announces the launch of Safe Cyber Space, an initiative aimed at raising awareness and equipping teenagers, their parents, and educators to face digital challenges, amid rising online risks. Led by AXA and with support from the AXA Foundation for Human Progress over the next three years, this project brings together UNICEF, Simplon Foundation, and everyone.AI with a shared goal: to better protect young people online.
The program will address key risks associated with digital use, such as phishing, cyber bullying, fake news, digital addiction, and the integration of best practices for Artificial Intelligence in education.
Overall, the initiative aims to reach over 15,000 middle school students through in-person sessions and nearly 3 million adults and children across France, Spain, and Portugal through national campaigns. The goal is to make Safe Cyber Space one of Europe’s most extensive awareness programs on these topics.
The project is also supported by France’s High Commissioner for Children, Sarah El Haïry, and Najat Maalla M’jid, UN Secretary-General’s Special Rapporteur on Violence Against Children.
This partnership will focus on three main areas, combining awareness, research, and training:
Raising Awareness Among Youth and Adults about Major Risks
Resources from Cybervengers.club, a series of educational mangas created by AXA, will be gradually deployed to 15,000 young people in partnership with Simplon Foundation through face-to-face sessions at schools and community centers. Additionally, UNICEF, an organization dedicated to child protection, will promote this awareness campaign within its networks in France. Finally, dedicated training sessions will be organized for parents, teachers, educators, and AXA employees in France and Spain to help them detect early warning signs and provide initial solutions.
National Campaigns and Studies to Better Understand Digital Usage
Through discussion groups, UNICEF will conduct in-depth research on digital habits of target audiences, aiming to publish strategic reports for policymakers and economic stakeholders. These will inform public policies and private initiatives to enhance online child protection.
Training for Parents and Educators
everyone.AI will actively contribute to developing online training modules dedicated to parents and educators. These educational contents will be progressively developed and deployed to AXA employees, partners, and the general public.
This partnership aligns with AXA’s commitment to fostering a safer and more responsible digital environment, consistent with the Group’s mission: to protect what matters.

items.title: Industry leaders scale full value chain for hydrogen mobility across Europe
items.text: Today at IAA Transportation, Volvo Group, Daimler Truck, Toyota Motor Corporation, Bosch, Air Liquide, TotalEnergies, TEAL Mobility, and MB Energy unveiled their plans to accelerate the rollout of hydrogen-powered vehicles across Europe. For the first time in Europe, the German ecosystem has put in place all the conditions for a scalable deployment of Hydrogen trucks by 2030, driven by the German authorities and European industrial leaders along the value chain. Building on the German deployment model as a practical baseline, scaling these solutions across the continent calls for aligned support from national governments and the European Commission to ensure long-term energy resilience and competitiveness.

items.title: Volvo Group announces energy park initiative as next step in Mariestad
items.text: Volvo Group announces next step in the Mariestad expansion process with plans for an energy park near the intended battery cell production site. The energy park will be developed along two parallel tracks: a large-scale battery storage facility and a future test bed for innovative energy solutions. Initially, the park is expected to provide approximately 70 MW/260 MWh of battery storage capacity, making it one of the largest energy parks in Sweden. The battery storage facility will support grid stability in the region, while the future test bed will enable the development and testing of new energy solutions. Together, the two tracks will contribute to the transition towards a more sustainable and resilient energy system.
